genre.zh: 日式漁市與漁人紀實攝影
genre.en: a Japanese fish-market and fisherman documentary: real harbour, ice, wet steel and early-morning light

s: the marbled wagyu rests on dark slate beside coarse salt and a sprig of rosemary, one narrow hard side light making every line of marbling glow
two hands in dark sleeves hold the wagyu toward the lens against a deep oxblood backdrop, hard light from the left
